name: ATFA Flooring Awards 2027
changelog: 1.8.1 (2026-10-20): Phil's alternative layout with 58 booths on the Expo page and the Hall 5 floor plan, with a new stand PDF (it now comes with the plugin). Phones: a tap or double tap on a stand can no longer press the card that slides in under it; choosing a stand nearby doesn't move the plan; tapping the page's picture of the plan opens the plan on that stand; turning the phone keeps the whole hall in view. Staff can share the private Expo page with a link that works for 24 hours, 3 days or 7 days.
